subject.custom_description: Exactly three recurring Pixar-style 3D household characters with locked designs. (1) Si Wajan (main): round non-stick frying pan with matte black body and terracotta wooden handle used like an arm, big expressive cartoon eyes, small mouth, rosy cheeks. (2) Sponge: rectangular dish sponge, soft yellow top layer and rough sage-green scrub side, small round eyes, wide friendly smile. (3) Sapu: traditional Indonesian ijuk broom with sage-green handle and brown fiber bristles bound with twine, thick expressive eyebrows, cheeky grin. Keep each character's colors, shape and proportions identical in every clip. No humans and no human hands in frame. No other talking objects.
